criteria.text: No change to the observable behavior of the purchase API or of PurchaseService; ADR 0011 and the security invariants continue to hold.
The existing purchase unit, integration, and system tests pass on the candidate.

findings.summary: The new helper selects the locking query through a boolean parameter (loadAuthorizedCustomer(id, permission, forUpdate)); behavior is preserved, but a boolean flag is a modest readability gain at best. Optional.

checks.command: git diff 88d7523 -U15 (saved to runs/K3-baseline/candidate.diff); review of PurchaseService callers, CustomerRepository and TenantContext signatures
checks.summary: Only PurchaseService.java changed (+12/-7). requireCustomer/requireCustomerForUpdate now delegate to loadAuthorizedCustomer with forUpdate=false/true. Write paths (lines 51, 95, 107, PURCHASE_WRITE) still use findByIdForUpdate; read paths (69, 78, 88, PURCHASE_READ) still use findById. Order preserved: requirePermission, then tenant context, then requireNonNull(id) (same left-to-right order as the original argument evaluation), then CustomerNotFoundException, then requireResourceAccess. No exception type, message, query, or lock semantics changed; the only import added is TenantId.

checks.environment: disposable git worktree at base plus the candidate diff (identity recomputed: same tree d470bc0), JDK 26.0.2+1.1-tem, Testcontainers
checks.summary: BUILD SUCCESSFUL. PurchaseControllerTest 15/15, PurchaseTest 2/2, PurchaseManagementIntegrationTest 5/5, PurchaseCurlSystemTest 1/1; 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped. Outputs: runs/K3-baseline/c1.log, c1-summary.txt.
BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 23/23 tests passed (includes purchase endpoints), confirming authorization still precedes validation. Output: runs/K3-baseline/c2.log.

limitations: Per benchmark constraints, the full ./gradlew test/check/build was not run; only filtered purchase-related and authorization-before-validation suites ran.
No dedicated concurrency test was run for the customer row lock; preservation of findByIdForUpdate on write paths was established by code reading (C1) and the existing integration tests.
